about: The playthrough from Cherrygrove's Pokemon Center to Elm's lab, as the tree's scripts order it. First the player's settings, through the start menu's OPTIONS: text fast, battle scene off, battle style set -- a player's choice that shortens every leg after it (the save keeps them). Then north across Route 30 to Mr. Pokemon's house: his Mystery Egg (bag:ITEM_MYSTERY_EGG 1), Professor Oak, the Pokedex and his number, a heal; Elm's panic call as the player steps out (FLAG_GOT_ELMS_PANIC_CALL, played through the Pokegear by goto's B); back down Route 30, whose battles go as the RNG falls -- on 9e2956609's ROM the Cyndaquil runs from an Oddish, a Hoppip and a Spinarak on the way up and beats a Hoppip on the way down, and a wild Hoothoot, after "You couldn't get away!", beats it and it blacks out to Cherrygrove's Pokemon Center ("You were overwhelmed by your defeat!"), 37891 frames in all; goto walks on from there; the rival at Cherrygrove's east edge (TRAINER_PASSERBY_BOY_3, his level-7 Totodile, whose Water Gun takes the level-5 Cyndaquil: it loses, and the game carries on and heals, as it does for this one battle), the nurse again, Route 29 and New Bark, and in Elm's lab the officer: the rival named on the keyboard (START to OK, A: HeartGold's default, Soul -- msg_0254 row 84, NamingScreen_SetDefaultName -- and the battles after call him "Rival Soul") and the egg handed to Elm (bag:ITEM_MYSTERY_EGG 0, VAR_SCENE_ELMS_LAB 4). The game's save in the lab. flee:40 runs from a wild Pokemon when the Cyndaquil has under 40% of its HP; the field's RNG is pinned and the battle's seed fixed.
